items.html: And this is the matter of what is written in the Zohar, Parashat Bamidbar, page 119, side 2, on the verse 'her voice goes like a serpent,' and on the verse 'she has fallen, she will not rise again' — that it is the matter of the tail and the head, etc. And the matter is that there remained in the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut of holiness only the aspect of her Malchut, which is her tenth, lowest aspect. And the rest of her nine upper Sefirot, which came to her from the nine first Sefirot of ZA, as is known, these descended to the Nukva of the Klipa.
